assertions.description: On a closed circular path, side="right" changes where glyphs are laid out (equivalent to reversing the path), measured via getStartPositionOfChar on two otherwise-identical textPaths.
assertions.test: (()=>{try{const NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';const svg=document.createElementNS(NS,'svg');svg.setAttribute('width','200');svg.setAttribute('height','200');svg.style.position='absolute';svg.style.left='-9999px';const p=document.createElementNS(NS,'path');p.setAttribute('id','cf-side-a');p.setAttribute('d','M 100,100 m -60,0 a 60,60 0 1,1 120,0 a 60,60 0 1,1 -120,0');p.setAttribute('fill','none');svg.appendChild(p);const mk=(s)=>{const t=document.createElementNS(NS,'text');t.setAttribute('font-size','16');const tp=document.createElementNS(NS,'textPath');tp.setAttribute('href','#cf-side-a');if(s)tp.setAttribute('side',s);tp.textContent='PROBE';t.appendChild(tp);svg.appendChild(t);return tp;};const a=mk(null),b=mk('right');document.body.appendChild(svg);let out=false;try{const pa=a.getStartPositionOfChar(0),pb=b.getStartPositionOfChar(0);out=Math.abs(pa.x-pb.x)+Math.abs(pa.y-pb.y)>1;}finally{svg.remove();}return out;}catch(e){return false;}})()

assertions.description: side="left" is the initial value: an explicit side="left" renders identically to omitting the attribute.
assertions.test: (()=>{try{const NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';const svg=document.createElementNS(NS,'svg');svg.setAttribute('width','200');svg.setAttribute('height','200');svg.style.position='absolute';svg.style.left='-9999px';const p=document.createElementNS(NS,'path');p.setAttribute('id','cf-side-b');p.setAttribute('d','M 100,100 m -60,0 a 60,60 0 1,1 120,0 a 60,60 0 1,1 -120,0');p.setAttribute('fill','none');svg.appendChild(p);const mk=(s)=>{const t=document.createElementNS(NS,'text');t.setAttribute('font-size','16');const tp=document.createElementNS(NS,'textPath');tp.setAttribute('href','#cf-side-b');if(s)tp.setAttribute('side',s);tp.textContent='PROBE';t.appendChild(tp);svg.appendChild(t);return tp;};const a=mk(null),b=mk('left');document.body.appendChild(svg);let out=false;try{const pa=a.getStartPositionOfChar(0),pb=b.getStartPositionOfChar(0);out=Math.abs(pa.x-pb.x)+Math.abs(pa.y-pb.y)<1;}finally{svg.remove();}return out;}catch(e){return false;}})()

assertions.description: An unrecognised side value (side="banana") is invalid and must render like the initial left value, not like right.
assertions.test: (()=>{try{const NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';const svg=document.createElementNS(NS,'svg');svg.setAttribute('width','200');svg.setAttribute('height','200');svg.style.position='absolute';svg.style.left='-9999px';const p=document.createElementNS(NS,'path');p.setAttribute('id','cf-side-c');p.setAttribute('d','M 100,100 m -60,0 a 60,60 0 1,1 120,0 a 60,60 0 1,1 -120,0');p.setAttribute('fill','none');svg.appendChild(p);const mk=(s)=>{const t=document.createElementNS(NS,'text');t.setAttribute('font-size','16');const tp=document.createElementNS(NS,'textPath');tp.setAttribute('href','#cf-side-c');if(s)tp.setAttribute('side',s);tp.textContent='PROBE';t.appendChild(tp);svg.appendChild(t);return tp;};const a=mk(null),b=mk('banana');document.body.appendChild(svg);let out=false;try{const pa=a.getStartPositionOfChar(0),pb=b.getStartPositionOfChar(0);out=Math.abs(pa.x-pb.x)+Math.abs(pa.y-pb.y)<1;}finally{svg.remove();}return out;}catch(e){return false;}})()

assertions.description: On an open path, side="right" effectively reverses the path, so text sets off from the far end: on a left-to-right line the first glyph's x moves toward the far end.
assertions.test: (()=>{try{const NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';const svg=document.createElementNS(NS,'svg');svg.setAttribute('width','220');svg.setAttribute('height','120');svg.style.position='absolute';svg.style.left='-9999px';const p=document.createElementNS(NS,'path');p.setAttribute('id','cf-side-d');p.setAttribute('d','M 20,60 L 200,60');p.setAttribute('fill','none');svg.appendChild(p);const mk=(s)=>{const t=document.createElementNS(NS,'text');t.setAttribute('font-size','16');const tp=document.createElementNS(NS,'textPath');tp.setAttribute('href','#cf-side-d');if(s)tp.setAttribute('side',s);tp.textContent='PROBE';t.appendChild(tp);svg.appendChild(t);return tp;};const a=mk(null),b=mk('right');document.body.appendChild(svg);let out=false;try{const pa=a.getStartPositionOfChar(0),pb=b.getStartPositionOfChar(0);out=(pb.x-pa.x)>10;}finally{svg.remove();}return out;}catch(e){return false;}})()

assertions.description: SVG 2 defines side as animatable (Animatable: yes): animating side between left and right must flip the rendered side over time.
assertions.test: Requires timed animation sampling (SMIL set/animate or scripted attribute flips across frames); the orbit-ticker concept flips side at runtime and measures the rendered lane after each flip.
